newsitem.title: USA: US heat oil stocks down 400,000 bbl last week - EIA.
newsitem.headline: US heat oil stocks down 400,000 bbl last week - EIA.

text.p: U.S. heating oil stocks dipped by 400,000 barrels to 55.3 million barrels in the week ending December 13 despite an increase in output in most areas, the Energy Information Administration said Wednesday.
Total U.S. distillate stocks, including heating oil and diesel, fell 300,000 barrels to 120.5 million barrels, leaving stocks about 13 million barrels below year ago levels.
Inventories in the key East Coast region were drawn down by 500,000 barrels to 45.4 million barrels last week, EIA said in its weekly distillate watch.
Average distillate demand over the last four weeks was 3.3 million barrels per day, matching last year's level, EIA said.
Imports, which averaged 200,000 bpd, were about 50,000 bpd less than last year at this time.
